intro.h2: One plan and one team for your Santa Barbara remodel
paragraphs: ELITE Remodels offers kitchen remodeling in Santa Barbara the way a good hotel runs a stay: one team looks after everything. Designers, material selection, permits, construction and professional cleaning all sit under one roof at the design center on Las Positas Road. You talk to one point of contact the whole way through.

Their tagline sums up what clients are buying: no chasing contractors, no surprise costs, no chaos in your home. Past clients from Hope Ranch to Solvang say their kitchens came in on time and on budget, and many come back for a bathroom next. On Google the firm holds 4.9 stars across 165 reviews.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and the rooms around them

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Full kitchen design and build, from moving appliances and adding walk-in pantries to cabinetry, stone counters, tile, plumbing and electrical. Styles range from Modern Mediterranean and Santa Barbara Spanish to Mid-Century Modern and Modern Farmhouse. You see the design rendered before construction starts.

image.alt: Modern Mediterranean kitchen in Santa Barbara with arched marble range alcove, light oak cabinets, white stone island and leather counter stools

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Bathrooms taken past a finish update into a calm, spa-like room: new layout where it helps, walk-in showers, tubs, tile, vanities, lighting and plumbing. Google reviewers mention bathroom remodels more than any other project, including primary baths and a guest bath done in true Santa Barbara Spanish style.

image.alt: Santa Barbara bathroom remodel with charcoal gray vanity, white counter, matte black wall faucets and frameless glass shower with gray subway tile

items.name: REFRESH by ELITE
items.blurb: For cosmetic and finish-level work that wraps up in weeks, not months: partial kitchen or bath refreshes, tub-to-shower conversions, new counters and backsplashes, cabinet refacing and vanity swaps. Same designers, same craftspeople and the same 5-year craftsmanship warranty as a full remodel.

image.alt: Recessed shower niche with blue and cream patterned tile framed by tan stacked tile in a Santa Barbara bathroom

items.name: Built-ins, Fireplaces and Additions
items.blurb: The team goes beyond the kitchen and bath when a home needs it: built-in cabinetry and shelving, fireplace surrounds, closet systems, laundry rooms, new flooring and additions. A Goleta couple had ELITE handle construction, flooring and painting alongside their kitchen, two baths and fireplaces.

image.alt: Walnut floating shelves beside white cabinetry with blue accent tile in a Santa Barbara kitchen remodel

about.h2: Meet founder Jerry Jaimes and the ELITE designers
about.text: Jerry Jaimes started ELITE nearly 20 years ago as a small home-repair business and grew it into a full design-and-build firm. A stay at a five-star hotel, where every staff member focused on service, shaped what he calls a concierge approach to remodeling. Today his in-house team of nearly 20 includes designers, licensed tradespeople and project managers. Designer Grace Gambetta is a fifth-generation Santa Barbara native who grew up on her father's job sites. Designer Jane spent nearly 20 years in custom wood flooring and specializes in custom cabinet design.

service_area.h2: Serving Santa Barbara, the coast and the Santa Ynez Valley
service_area.text: ELITE works across Santa Barbara County, from Carpinteria and Summerland up through Montecito, Hope Ranch and Goleta, and over the pass to Solvang, Santa Ynez, Los Olivos and Buellton. Recent projects include kitchens on the Mesa, the Riviera and in San Roque. The design center is in Santa Barbara, so most clients stop in to choose tile, stone and cabinet finishes in person.

faq.h2: Common questions about remodeling with ELITE

items.q: Do I need to hire a designer and a contractor separately?
items.a: No. ELITE's in-house team covers design, materials, project management and construction. You work with one point of contact from the first meeting to the final cleaning, so there is no chasing separate trades or passing messages between a designer and a builder.

items.q: Is REFRESH by ELITE or a full remodel right for me?
items.a: REFRESH covers cosmetic and finish-level work like new counters, backsplashes, vanities or a tub-to-shower conversion. If your project moves walls, changes the layout, adds square footage or needs construction drawings, a full design-build remodel is the better fit. Schedule a consultation and the team will tell you which one.

items.q: What warranty comes with the work?
items.a: ELITE provides a 5-year craftsmanship warranty. It applies to full design-build remodels and to smaller REFRESH projects alike. The craftsmen who do the work are part of ELITE's own insured and bonded in-house team rather than outside crews brought in for your job.

Yes. The design center is at 2267 Las Positas Rd in Santa Barbara. It is open Monday through Friday from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Dropping in is a good way to meet a designer and see finishes before you plan.

items.q: Will my remodel stay on budget?
items.a: Staying on budget is the point clients raise most in their testimonials. Kitchens in Summerland, on the Riviera and in Rancho Embarcadero came in on budget, and one owner said there were no surprises. Planning and buying materials before demolition is a big part of how the team keeps costs steady.
